sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "school_performance"."School_Id" AS e, "school"."Boys_or_Girls" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "school_performance" JOIN "school" ON "school"."School_ID" = "school_performance"."School_Id"  GROUP BY "school_performance"."School_Id", "school"."Boys_or_Girls"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the g total of number of school_performance records (g level)
rank within the group by number of school_performance records, keep the top 3
